description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Rude] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Rude
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Lightning or Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Rude after using a Lightning or Earth ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Grand Spark+
description.text: Five single ranged hybrid attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Quake First+
description.text: Four single ranged hybrid attacks (1.10 or 3.60 each), causes [Imperil Earth 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)] to the target

description.name: Spirit Attack: Rude
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] to the target with 0-4/5 VII allies in the party, Grants [Damage +30% Boost 2] to all allies if there are 5 VII allies in the party

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
